title: fix: prevent indexing of public share assets
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the generic public-share preview image and rejected share responses missing the search-engine indexing directive already applied to public conversations.

## User Impact

Compliant search engines are asked not to index public share documents or assets, including fallback and error responses. Social previews remain fetchable. These directives are advisory, not access control, and cannot prevent hostile scraping of deliberately public content.

## Why This Change Was Made

Apply the existing noindex, nofollow policy once at the owned share namespace before route dispatch, covering static cards without changing authentication, caching, or robots.txt. Align the security documentation with the current public text, tool-summary, and image contract.

Requested by @vincentkoc.

## Work sessions

- [Original discussion with @vincentkoc](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/dashboard/4f7c111f-e0bb-4b15-8850-afa57cf68cd8)
- [Implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/subagent/94885197-2771-4eab-921c-a28f3224e377)

## Evidence

- Both real Gateway HTTP routing matrix variants fail before the fix specifically on /share/card.png missing X-Robots-Tag.
- Root and /control matrix: 2/2 pass; GET/HEAD, exact PNG bytes, 304, 406, invalid paths, rejected methods, legacy fallback, missing assets, and preparing-root 503s. Wall time 64.66 seconds, callbacks 1.063 seconds; cold worker preparation dominates. CI workflow elapsed: 1,223 seconds (not a per-file benchmark).
- Canonical chat, legacy public session, and media siblings: 39/39 pass, 60.44 seconds wall time.
- Targeted typecheck, lint, formatting, and git diff checks pass. Fresh context-complete independent P0–P2 review is clean.
- No rendered appearance or live-Gateway change; no screenshots required. Existing conversation noindex protection is not presented as newly added.


- [Completed exact-head CI run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38749704822): success; required checks cleared before merge.
